_doc: NPCs do Porto do Despertar (GDD 17.7, proximos-passos 3.1). build/face/desc entram no style_block.txt (mesmo bloco de estilo do Viajante v2, tools/art/character_pipeline/p_c1m.txt). height = altura do personagem no quadro 96x96 (adulto 84 como o Viajante; crianca menor). prop = objeto que a IA deve manter nas edicoes.

merchant.build: sturdy average build, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
merchant.face: middle-aged man with an anime-style face, medium-sized friendly eyes, warm broad smile, short neat dark beard
merchant.desc: cheerful market merchant, tanned skin, short dark hair under a flat-brimmed straw hat, cream linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves, mustard-yellow vest, long green work apron with pockets, red cloth sash belt with a small leather coin pouch, brown trousers, sturdy brown leather boots
merchant.prop: straw hat, green apron and coin pouch

master_brisa.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_brisa.face: middle-aged woman with an anime-style face, sharp medium-sized eyes, stern calm expression, a small scar on the chin
master_brisa.desc: veteran sword master, short steel-gray hair tied back in a small tight bun, brown leather jerkin with small steel shoulder pads, a red scarf tied around the neck, dark brown trousers, tall dark leather boots, a long machete in a leather sheath at her left hip
master_brisa.prop: red scarf, steel shoulder pads and sheathed machete

master_orvalho.build: short plump build with a round belly, proportions about 3.5 heads tall
master_orvalho.face: jolly middle-aged man with an anime-style face, small round glasses, kind eyes, big friendly smile, short brown beard
master_orvalho.desc: cheerful herbalist mage, teal-green knee-length robe covered with many small pockets holding tiny glass vials of herbs, a tall pointed straw hat, a leather belt with pouches, soft brown boots, three small glowing warm-yellow firefly lights floating around him
master_orvalho.prop: pointed straw hat, round glasses, teal robe with vials and small floating yellow lights

boatman.build: wiry lean build, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
boatman.face: elderly man with an anime-style face, kind medium-sized eyes, warm smile, short white beard
boatman.desc: weathered river boatman, sun-tanned skin, short curly white hair, faded blue and white horizontally striped sleeveless shirt, rolled-up beige canvas trousers, a coiled rope hanging over one shoulder, brown leather boots, holding a long wooden boat pole upright in his right hand
boatman.prop: striped shirt, coiled rope and long wooden boat pole

fruit_vendor.build: slim average build, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
fruit_vendor.face: friendly woman in her forties with an anime-style face, medium-sized warm eyes, bright smile
fruit_vendor.desc: fruit seller at a riverside market, dark wavy shoulder-length hair tied with a yellow headscarf, orange blouse with small white flower prints, long green skirt, short white apron, brown sandal-boots, holding a woven straw basket full of colorful fruits (mangoes, oranges, bananas) against her hip
fruit_vendor.prop: yellow headscarf and straw fruit basket

gate_guard.build: fit lean build, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
gate_guard.face: young adult man with an anime-style face, sharp medium-sized eyes, serious but friendly expression
gate_guard.desc: town gate guard, short black hair under a round steel kettle helmet, blue padded gambeson tunic with a yellow sash across the chest, brown leather belt, brown trousers, tall leather boots, holding a wooden spear with a steel tip upright in his right hand
gate_guard.prop: steel kettle helmet, blue gambeson with yellow sash and upright spear

fisherman.build: thin lanky build, slightly relaxed posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
fisherman.face: old man with an anime-style face, calm half-closed eyes, gentle smile, gray mustache
fisherman.desc: old riverside fisherman, wide-brimmed frayed straw hat, open light-green short-sleeved shirt over a white undershirt, rolled-up brown trousers, simple brown leather boots, a small woven fish basket at his hip, holding a long bamboo fishing rod resting on his shoulder
fisherman.prop: wide straw hat, fish basket and bamboo fishing rod

curious_child.build: child proportions, about 3 heads tall, skinny arms and legs
curious_child.face: curious cheerful boy about nine years old with an anime-style face, big bright eager eyes, wide gap-toothed grin
curious_child.desc: town kid, messy short black hair with a cowlick, loose cream linen tunic with a red patch on the shoulder, short brown shorts held by a rope belt, a small bandage on one knee, little brown boots, holding a small wooden toy sailboat in one hand
curious_child.prop: cream tunic, rope belt and small wooden toy sailboat

traveler_male.prop: blue zip hoodie, spiky brown hair, dark blue jeans, white high-top sneakers and small brown leather backpack

traveler_female.prop: blue zip hoodie, long brown ponytail, dark jeans shorts over black tights, white high-top sneakers and small brown leather backpack

master_jatoba.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_jatoba.face: middle-aged Brazilian man with warm brown skin and an anime-style face, sharp medium-sized eyes, calm confident half smile, short curly black hair graying at the temples, a trimmed short beard
master_jatoba.desc: veteran blade master of the savanna, sleeveless tan leather jerkin over a cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, a red cloth sash at the waist, brown trousers tied at the calves, a wide-brimmed brown leather hat hanging on his back, a long machete in a leather sheath at his left hip
master_jatoba.prop: leather hat on the back, red sash and sheathed machete

master_candeia.build: slim graceful build, upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_candeia.face: elderly Brazilian woman with dark brown skin and an anime-style face, kind wise eyes, gentle smile, white hair in a braided bun with a small yellow flower
master_candeia.desc: wise arcane master, sleeveless ochre tunic over a long plum-purple skirt, a woven shawl with orange and teal stripes over the shoulders, a tall wooden staff topped with a small brass oil lamp glowing warm yellow, two tiny glowing yellow firefly lights floating near her
master_candeia.prop: striped shawl and wooden staff with a glowing brass oil lamp

master_guiomar.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_guiomar.face: woman in her forties with light olive skin and an anime-style face, sharp determined eyes, dark brown hair in a single braid
master_guiomar.desc: halberd master of an old fortress, a polished steel breastplate over a wine-red padded tunic with a small blue and white tile pattern trim, dark trousers, brown leather boots, holding a tall halberd upright at her side

master_tsubaki.build: slim graceful build, upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_tsubaki.face: young woman with light skin and an anime-style face, calm focused eyes, black hair in a high ponytail tied with a red cord, a small red camellia flower pin
master_tsubaki.desc: naginata master, a white wrapped kimono-style top and wide dark indigo hakama trousers, a dark sash, straw sandals with white socks, holding a long naginata polearm upright at her side

master_solveig.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_solveig.face: woman with fair freckled skin and an anime-style face, bright blue eyes, confident smile, long blonde hair in two thick braids
master_solveig.desc: shield master of the frozen fjords, a blue wool cloak lined with white fur, a chainmail shirt over a brown tunic, fur-trimmed boots, a round wooden shield painted with a simple blue wave pattern on her left arm, a short hand axe at her belt
master_solveig.prop: fur cloak, round wooden shield and hand axe

master_nicandro.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_nicandro.face: middle-aged man with olive skin and an anime-style face, calm sharp eyes, short curly dark hair and a short dark beard
master_nicandro.desc: spear master of the coast of columns, a white knee-length tunic with a blue meander pattern border, a brown leather belt, a round bronze shield on his back, leather sandals with straps up the calves, holding a long spear upright
master_nicandro.prop: bronze shield on the back and long spear

master_seneb.build: slim graceful build, upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_seneb.face: man with brown skin and an anime-style face, calm intelligent eyes lined with dark kohl, shaved head
master_seneb.desc: scribe and blade master of the desert river, a white pleated linen kilt, a wide collar necklace of turquoise and gold beads, gold armbands, leather sandals, a curved bronze sickle sword at his belt and a small wooden scroll case at his side
master_seneb.prop: bead collar, curved bronze sword and scroll case

master_ewan.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_ewan.face: young man with fair skin and an anime-style face, friendly green eyes, red hair tied back, a short red beard
master_ewan.desc: longsword and harp master of the misty isles, a green and brown plaid cloak pinned at the shoulder with a round silver brooch, a cream linen shirt, brown trousers and boots, a small wooden harp hanging at his side, a longsword across his back
master_ewan.prop: plaid cloak, small harp and longsword on the back

master_zlata.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_zlata.face: woman with fair skin and an anime-style face, keen grey eyes, a long light brown braid over the shoulder
master_zlata.desc: archer and axe master of the steppe, a white linen shirt with red embroidered sleeves under a sleeveless dark green long coat, a round fur hat, tall brown leather boots, a wooden bow and quiver on her back, a hand axe at her belt
master_zlata.prop: fur hat, green coat, bow on the back and hand axe

master_xiaoyu.build: slim graceful build, upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_xiaoyu.face: young woman with light skin and an anime-style face, serene eyes, black hair in a neat bun with a green jade hairpin
master_xiaoyu.desc: swordmaster of the jade empire, a flowing light blue robe with wide white sleeves and a jade-green sash, soft black cloth shoes, holding a slim straight double-edged sword in its sheath at her side
master_xiaoyu.prop: light blue robe, jade hairpin and slim straight sword

master_citlali.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_citlali.face: woman with brown skin and an anime-style face, strong confident eyes, long black hair in a braid woven with a turquoise ribbon
master_citlali.desc: obsidian blade master of the jungle, a white cotton tunic with a red and turquoise geometric border, a short cape with a spotted jaguar fur pattern, leather sandals, holding a flat wooden club edged with small black obsidian blades
master_citlali.prop: jaguar pattern cape and wooden club edged with obsidian

master_taquari.build: athletic lean build, straight upright posture, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
master_taquari.face: middle-aged Brazilian man with sun-tanned light brown skin and an anime-style face, narrow focused eyes, calm serious expression, long black hair tied in a low ponytail, a thin mustache
master_taquari.desc: veteran archer master of the savanna, holding a tall longbow made of pale yellow bamboo cane upright in his left hand, a bamboo quiver full of fletched arrows on his back, a sleeveless olive-green leather jerkin over a cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, a woven golden straw sash at the waist, leather bracers on the forearms, khaki trousers wrapped with cloth at the calves, brown boots
master_taquari.prop: bamboo longbow, bamboo quiver and straw sash

elder_ze_ferreiro.build: short sturdy build with slightly hunched rounded shoulders of an old man, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
elder_ze_ferreiro.face: very old man with an anime-style face, deep wrinkles on the forehead and cheeks, bushy white eyebrows, bald head with a ring of short white hair, a thick white mustache, kind tired eyes, warm tan skin
elder_ze_ferreiro.desc: old village blacksmith, a heavy dark brown leather apron over a sooty gray work shirt with rolled sleeves, thick brown leather gloves, a heavy iron smithing hammer held down in his right hand, a small cloth towel over one shoulder, dark trousers and sturdy boots
elder_ze_ferreiro.prop: leather apron, white mustache and iron smithing hammer

elder_aninha.build: small thin frail build of an old woman with a slightly stooped back, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
elder_aninha.face: very old grandmother with an anime-style face, many soft wrinkles, gentle smiling narrow eyes, white hair in a bun, warm brown skin
elder_aninha.desc: old folk herbalist grandmother, a red and yellow flowered headscarf tied over her white hair, a cream blouse with a knitted brown shawl over the shoulders, a long dark green skirt, a woven straw basket full of green herbs hanging on one arm, leaning on a simple wooden walking cane in the other hand, simple brown shoes
elder_aninha.prop: flowered headscarf, herb basket and wooden cane

elder_tiao.build: broad strong build for an old man with thick arms and a slightly bent back, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
elder_tiao.face: very old man with an anime-style face, deep wrinkles, a long white beard, bald head with white hair on the sides, bushy white eyebrows, stern but kind eyes, weathered tan skin
elder_tiao.desc: strong old warrior of the tortoise, a sleeveless vest reinforced with rounded brown tortoise shell plates with ochre borders, a gray long-sleeved shirt, a wide leather belt, dark brown trousers, heavy boots, leaning on a thick gnarled wooden staff held upright in one hand
elder_tiao.prop: tortoise shell plated vest, long white beard and gnarled wooden staff

dona_jacinta.build: small plump build of a kind older woman, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
dona_jacinta.face: friendly woman in her sixties with an anime-style face, a few soft wrinkles, warm smiling eyes, rosy cheeks, gentle smile
dona_jacinta.desc: riverside market lace-maker and stall keeper, warm tan skin, graying dark hair under a red and white checkered headscarf tied at the nape, a lilac blouse with puffed short sleeves, a long mustard-yellow skirt, a white lace-trimmed apron, brown sandals, holding a round woven straw sieve basket with a crossed straw pattern against her hip
dona_jacinta.prop: checkered headscarf, white lace apron and round woven straw sieve basket

firmino_insone.build: very thin gaunt lanky build with slightly hunched tired shoulders, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
firmino_insone.face: exhausted middle-aged man with an anime-style face, very dark purple bags and deep circles under heavy-lidded tired eyes, thin face, short messy stubble, weary sad worried expression, clearly a living ordinary human
firmino_insone.desc: sleepless villager from a foggy village, fair light-peach skin with warm healthy undertone, messy unkempt dark brown hair, an old faded blue and white striped long-sleeved nightshirt pajama with a patched elbow, loose gray-blue pajama trousers, worn brown slippers, holding up a small old iron oil lantern with a bright warm orange flame glowing inside in one hand
firmino_insone.prop: striped old nightshirt pajama and glowing iron oil lantern

dona_celeste.build: slim average build, proportions about 3.5 heads tall with a small head relative to the body
dona_celeste.face: worried woman in her early thirties with an anime-style face, medium-sized anxious eyes, furrowed eyebrows, small worried frown, small gold hoop earrings
dona_celeste.desc: riverside townswoman and mother looking for her son, light brown skin, long dark brown hair gathered in a loose low bun with loose strands, a plain light-blue blouse with rolled sleeves, a long dark navy skirt down to the ankles, a cream cloth shawl tied over the shoulders, simple brown sandals, one hand pressed against her chest and the other hand raised to her cheek in worry
dona_celeste.prop: light-blue blouse, navy long skirt, cream shawl and low bun

curupira.build: child proportions, about 3 heads tall, skinny arms and legs
curupira.face: mischievous playful boy about nine years old with an anime-style face, big bright amber eyes, sly cheeky grin
curupira.desc: ordinary forest village boy, warm brown skin, wild spiky bright red-orange hair sticking up like flames, a sleeveless leaf-green tunic with a ragged hem, short brown shorts, a belt of twisted green jungle vine tied at the waist, simple brown leather sandals with both feet pointing forward normally, a small green leaf tucked in his hair
curupira.prop: spiky red hair, leaf-green tunic, brown shorts and vine belt
